Panorama Dental is a family dental practice that has been treating patients in Panorama since 1998. The practice covers preventative, restorative and aesthetic dentistry, including professional oral-hygiene care, fillings, crowns, dentures, root-canal treatment, bridges and tooth removal, together with removable appliances such as night guards and sports guards for patients who need extra protection.

For anxious or nervous patients, laughing gas and conscious sedation are available where appropriate, and the practice describes its rooms as a family-friendly, non-threatening space rather than a clinical one. Medical-aid claims are submitted electronically, which keeps paperwork to a minimum for patients on a scheme.

Based in Panorama, Cape Town, the practice treats patients of every age, from toddlers having their first check-up through to grandparents, and suits families who want one dental home for the whole household.

Tafelsig Clinic is a public primary healthcare facility serving the Tafelsig area of Mitchells Plain, historically run as part of the City of Cape Town's City Health service. The clinic opened in 1994 and in 2008 became the first City-run facility to use the Matrix treatment model for outpatient substance-abuse treatment, a programme that has shaped much of its community health work since.

In February 2026 the City announced a R10.5 million upgrade of the clinic, adding a first-floor extension, a lift and new staircases along with ground-floor improvements, with construction expected to run through October 2026.

The clinic serves residents of Tafelsig and the surrounding Mitchells Plain community, providing primary healthcare and substance-abuse outpatient services close to home.

The kitchen serves traditional Moroccan dishes such as tajines, couscous, harira soup and mezze platters, with lamb tajines and lamb-shank couscous among its signature mains, alongside vegetarian options for diners who do not eat meat.

The restaurant draws on the wider tradition of Moroccan, Middle Eastern and Arab cooking, and current online ordering listings show it offers both delivery and takeaway in addition to sit-down dining. items.description:
Bardelli's is an Italian pizzeria and restaurant in Kenilworth, Cape Town, serving Italian-styled food since 1992. The restaurant serves pizzas, pasta, steaks and desserts, and says its pizzas are described by locals as among the best in the Cape.

The restaurant says it won the Porcupine Ridge Pizzeria Challenge in both 2024 and 2025. Its weekly deals include half-price margarita cocktails on Mondays for meals of R150 or more, wine at cost price on Wednesdays, and two Olympia pizzas with a bottle of wine for R500 on Tuesdays.

Bardelli's sits on the corner of Kenilworth Road and Wessels Road, and suits a sit-down Italian dinner, a date night or a relaxed pizza with friends. Tables can be reserved by phone or WhatsApp through the website.

Braude's Pharmacy is an independent community pharmacy on Lawrence Road in Athlone, founded in 1948. The business says its focus is on supporting everyone in the community, from grandmothers to children in need, and that it never turns a customer away.

The pharmacy is open from 08:30 to 22:00 every day, including public holidays, with compounding services and a clinic staffed by four nurses and a prescribing pharmacist. It describes long experience with skin conditions and says its prescribing clinic is run by a pharmacist with years of experience.

The pharmacy suits residents of Athlone who need a late-opening pharmacy for prescriptions, clinic care and personal service close to home.

Constantia Pharmacy is an independent pharmacy inside Constantia Village Centre on Constantia Main Road, established in 1968. It describes its approach as personalised and professional, with a holistic view of health and wellness for individuals and families.

The clinic offers health checks, flu vaccinations, blood pressure and glucose checks, vitamin B injections and lipid profiles. The dispensary handles prescriptions, over-the-counter medicines and medication management, and medical aid is accepted. The front shop stocks vitamins and supplements, homeopathic medicines, first-aid products and beauty products.

Customers can submit a script through the website or chat on WhatsApp, and the pharmacy suits families in Constantia who want dispensing and everyday health services in one place.

Dis-Chem at Table Bay Mall is a pharmacy with a dispensary, a clinic, click and collect and a delivery service called DeliverD. The store is on the corner of the R27 and Berkshire Boulevard in Bloubergstrand, inside the West Coast mall.

The clinic keeps its own weekday hours, opening at 09:00 and closing at 17:30 Monday to Friday. The store also carries beauty, healthy food, sport supplement and well-being ranges, with staff on hand to advise on products.

The shop suits Table Bay Mall visitors who need prescriptions filled, clinic care or a health and beauty top-up while they shop at the mall.

This general practice on Vasco Boulevard in Goodwood offers consultations for adults and children, with the practice's own motto that health comes first. Consultation fees are listed at R580 for adults and children and R550 for pensioners, excluding medication.

The practice lists extra charges for urine, pregnancy and sugar tests and ECGs. It also offers routine check-ups, diagnosis and a medication prescription service, and the website is written in both English and Afrikaans.

The website describes a holistic approach that treats each patient as a whole rather than a single symptom. The practice suits patients in Goodwood who want a doctor for routine care and prescriptions.
